gameplayPillars.title: Open-World Exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Roam the Commonwealth, discover settlements, ruins, vaults and faction-controlled locations.

gameplayPillars.title: Character Building
gameplayPillars.description: Use SPECIAL stats, perks, equipment and combat styles to define the Sole Survivor.

gameplayPillars.title: Settlement Construction
gameplayPillars.description: Build and manage settlements using gathered resources, defenses, power and supply lines.

gameplayPillars.title: Factions and Choices
gameplayPillars.description: Join or oppose major factions whose conflicts determine the direction of the main story.

gameplayPillars.title: Crafting and Loot
gameplayPillars.description: Modify weapons, armor and power armor using extensive crafting systems.

storyChapters.title: Vault 111
storyChapters.body: The Sole Survivor awakens after the destruction of the old world and leaves Vault 111 to search for a missing child.

storyChapters.title: The Commonwealth
storyChapters.body: The search leads through post-war Boston and into conflict among the Minutemen, Brotherhood of Steel, Railroad and Institute.

storyChapters.title: A New Future
storyChapters.body: Faction choices shape the ending while expansions open additional stories including Far Harbor and Nuka-World.

perfNotes: Bethesda officially provides 30, 40 and 60 FPS targets on Switch 2. Quality mode targets up to 1080p handheld and 1440p docked; Balanced 40 FPS uses lower dynamic resolutions, including roughly 810p-990p handheld and around 1080p docked in third-party testing. Higher-frame-rate modes trade image quality for performance.

faq.q: What is included in Anniversary Edition?
faq.a: The base game, all six official expansions and more than 150 curated Creation Club items.

faq.q: What frame-rate modes are available on Switch 2?
faq.a: Bethesda provides 30, 40 and 60 FPS target modes.
The main story is roughly 27 hours in long-standing crowdsourced data, while exploration and DLC can push a full playthrough well beyond 80 hours.
No. Fallout 4 is a single-player RPG.

faq.q: Does it include Far Harbor and Nuka-World?
faq.a: Yes. Both are included along with Automatron and the Workshop expansions.

faq.q: Is this the first native Fallout 4 release on a Nintendo console?
faq.a: Yes. Anniversary Edition brought Fallout 4 natively to Nintendo Switch 2.

verdictSummary: An enormous open-world RPG package and the first native Fallout 4 release on a Nintendo console, combining the base game, all major expansions and a very large Creation Club collection.
verdictPros: 150+ Creation Club items built into the Switch 2 version
verdictCons: Nintendo Switch 2 version does not expose the full Creations menu

reviews.quote: The original release was critically acclaimed for world exploration, crafting and player freedom, though dialogue and technical issues were common criticisms.
Reviewers praised portability and mode flexibility while noting image-quality compromises, especially at higher frame rates.
The edition includes the base game, all six expansions and more than 150 curated Creation Club items.
